scope: Eight illustrative text positions and eight audio positions; full T5 encoder, causal decoder, cross-attention, and four codebook logits. EnCodec synthesis excluded.
title: An orchestra of connections
transform: Original bundled x maps monotonically to an open 323-degree ring; original y maps to radius, z to a small screen offset. Every source route and segment is rasterized. No ring closure or additional graph links.
semantics: Checkpoint-derived aggregated connectivity, not individual neurons or measured activation. Brightness uses source route strength normalized separately per edge family (75th percentile, asinh, clipping), followed by common tone mapping. Structural links also contribute. Brightness is not globally comparable weight mass; overlap and segment sampling density add light, so raster brightness is not globally mass-conserving.
renderer: NumPy bilinear density splats with Gaussian bloom; deterministic
